purpose: Canonical names, families, provenance roles and leakage constraints for TOPA POSS-I artifact/point-source image-forensics features.

upstream_reference.note: TOPA does not treat upstream thresholds or interpretations as truth. It imports measurements and provenance, not conclusions.

features.name: morph_fwhm_image
features.meaning: Candidate FWHM_IMAGE from SExtractor.

features.name: morph_fwhm_ratio
features.meaning: Candidate FWHM relative to local Gaia-derived PSF median.

features.name: morph_spread_model
features.meaning: PSFEx SPREAD_MODEL measurement.

features.name: morph_spreaderr_model
features.meaning: Per-source uncertainty on SPREAD_MODEL.

features.name: morph_spread_snr
features.meaning: Deviation from local PSF SPREAD_MODEL reference divided by per-source SPREADERR_MODEL; retained as a measurement, not as an admitted hard gate.

features.name: morph_psf_fwhm_median
features.meaning: Local tile PSF FWHM median from reference stars.

features.name: morph_psf_spread_median
features.meaning: Local reference-star SPREAD_MODEL median.

features.name: morph_psf_star_count
features.meaning: Number of reference stars supporting local PSF estimate.

features.name: shape_profile_diff
features.meaning: Radial-profile difference against local flux-matched stars.

features.name: shape_circularity
features.meaning: Contour circularity from pixel cutout.

features.name: shape_area
features.meaning: Measured contour area in candidate cutout.

features.name: shape_defect
features.meaning: Convexity/shape-defect measurement.

features.name: shape_circle_deviation
features.meaning: Deviation from fitted circular contour.

features.name: shape_elongation
features.meaning: Image elongation measurement.

features.name: shape_failed
features.meaning: Whether pixel-shape extraction failed; missingness itself can reflect acquisition quality and must be audited.

features.name: geo_sep_own_deg
features.meaning: Angular separation from the actual detection plate centre.

features.name: geo_edge_dist_arcmin
features.meaning: Distance from candidate position to physical scanned-array boundary in that plate's own WCS.

features.name: geo_is_primary
features.meaning: Whether the detection plate is the nearest-centre primary plate for the sky position. Partition only, not a quality truth.

features.name: geo_sep_primary_deg
features.meaning: Angular separation to primary plate centre.

features.name: geo_sep_margin
features.meaning: Nearest-versus-second-nearest plate centre separation margin; near zero marks ambiguous boundary geometry.

features.name: crossscan_scos_r1_matched
features.meaning: Independent digitisation of POSS-I E material has a positional counterpart within frozen match radius.

features.name: crossscan_scos_r1_sep_arcsec
features.meaning: Angular separation to matched independent SuperCOSMOS R1 detection.

features.name: ptf_covered
features.meaning: Whether PTF observed this sky position sufficiently for the configured modern-epoch test.

features.name: ptf_match
features.meaning: Modern-epoch PTF counterpart under the configured quality gate.

features.name: ptf_ngoodobs
features.meaning: Number of good PTF observations for a matched source when available.

features.name: persist_n_other_plates
features.meaning: Number of other POSS-I plates whose footprints cover this position.

features.name: persist_n_confirming
features.meaning: Number of independent other POSS-I plates with a raw detection near this candidate.

features.name: persist_any
features.meaning: Candidate is seen on at least one other POSS-I plate/epoch.

features.name: dup_cluster_size
features.meaning: Multiplicity of near-duplicate detections before global deduplication.

features.name: dup_nearest_sep_arcsec
features.meaning: Nearest pre-dedup detection separation across tiles/plates.

features.name: acq_wcs_offset_arcsec
features.meaning: Magnitude of plate WCS correction/provenance offset.

features.name: acq_exposure_min
features.meaning: Plate exposure duration in minutes. This is ordinary photographic exposure and is unrelated to nuclear exposure.

features.name: acq_tile_rows_emitted_s0
features.meaning: Candidate count emitted from this tile before global aggregation; local contamination/density context only.

features.name: acq_tile_raw_detection_count
features.meaning: Raw detection population feeding tile-level filters.

features.name: acq_astrometric_refit_residual_arcsec
features.meaning: Per-tile astrometric refit residual, preserving local failures rather than only plate medians.

features.name: context_local_detection_density
source_examples: derived from tile/raw detection ledger and usable sky area
features.meaning: Local raw detection density under a preregistered area definition.

features.name: context_background_median
features.meaning: Local background level in candidate cutout.

features.name: context_background_mad
features.meaning: Robust local background dispersion.

features.name: context_peak_snr
features.meaning: Peak or PSF-weighted signal-to-noise under a frozen estimator.

features.name: crossband_blue_match
source_examples: future public POSS-I O/blue plate reconstruction
features.meaning: Presence of a positionally compatible blue-band detection under an explicitly time-aware matching rule.

features.name: crossband_red_blue_sep_arcsec
features.meaning: Angular separation between red and blue detections when comparable.

features.name: crossband_time_delta_min
features.meaning: Observation-time offset between compared red and blue plates; required to avoid treating non-simultaneous observations as spectral evidence.

family_witness_rule: A family may exist in the feature rail, but if that family contributes to labels in a given training arm, every predictor from that family must be removed for that arm.
